title: 03 · Claymorphism · Wayfold new-hire onboarding
strengths: One object drawn with craft that is also the next task: the new hire's badge on its lanyard, clay-shaded in SVG (inner light, inner shade, cast shadow), showing only true data (name, role, company, floor)
A real first week: 6 of 12 done, before-day-one collapsed to '5 of 5 done', day one with times and rooms, buddy and manager by name, the rest of the week as three tiles
Two clay hues with one job each (violet = done and progress, lemon = next), dark ink everywhere except on violet, measured white-on-violet at 4.62:1 after capping the clay highlight
slop_signals: Violet #6D4AFF on lilac-white with a lemon second accent: the default AI palette that rules.md warns about
The badge carries initials 'TR' in a violet disc where a real badge has a photo, so the one crafted object still reads as a placeholder
The white task rows are soft UI, not clay (the builder says so); clay lives only in the checks, button and badge
'6 days to go' lemon pill and 'Next' tag are stock onboarding chips
fixes: Pick a palette that is not violet-on-lavender: one strong hue for progress and neutral greys, kept cool
Give the badge a portrait (an open-licence photo or an illustrated face) and real lanyard detail, so the object earns the page
Correct the start date for 2026 (Monday is 19 October, 5 days away; or keep 20 October and call it Tuesday) and recheck 'Wed 14:00' and 'due Wednesday'
Rename Tomás and Calder Street; both names are already used in three other showcase pieces
